source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The identity header returned by MimeHeaders_get is adopted into a block-scoped nsAutoCString. It remains valid for the identity lookup and creator-key setter; that setter uses the non-structured header slot backed by an owned nsCString array. This replaces the later manual free. The separate detected-charset assignment now moves the successful nonempty local result, but no speedup, compile result or forwarding-cure claim follows from static source.
title: The draft MIME follow-up scopes identity-header ownership through the creator-key copy
